design.page-subtitle: An interactive reference for the pixel design system: components, icons, palette, type, motion and states
design.intro: Pixel Rig · a 16-bit radio front panel. The whole interface is drawn as one physical device: hard borders, hard shadows, an integer pixel grid and frame-by-frame animation. Everything below can be clicked, changed and traced back to the token behind it.
design.overview-principles-hint: Filter by dimension; click a card to send its value into the quick-reference table.
design.principle-corners: No radius / no blur / no gradient
design.principle-corners-desc: Every edge is square, shadows are hard offsets only, surfaces never get glows or gradients.
design.principle-grid-desc: Control heights are 24 / 32 / 40 / 48px and layout spacing is a multiple of 4; tight spacing inside controls may sit on the 2px pixel grid.
design.principle-icon-desc: Path coordinates are integers; scaling only by integer multiples of 24 stays crisp.
design.principle-weight-desc: The bitmap font only has 400; emphasis comes from color, borders and heading classes.
design.principle-shadow-desc: Blur radius is always 0; depth is expressed with 2 / 4 / 6 / 8px offsets.
design.principle-steps-desc: Transitions jump frame by frame with no smooth interpolation; scale animation is banned.
design.principle-token-desc: 11 schemes only swap semantic variables; state colors are separate and no literal colors go in source.
design.principle-aria-desc: Hover, disabled and error are driven by :disabled, aria-invalid and aria-pressed.
design.comp-buttons-hint: Click any button; the readout on the right remembers the last variant and size used.
design.comp-dialog-desc: Focus stays inside, background scroll is locked; Esc or the veil closes it and it unmounts only after the exit animation.
design.comp-sheet-desc: A secondary panel sliding in from the right for work that should not break the main flow.
design.comp-tooltip-text: Tooltips render through a Portal so they never stretch the parent layout
design.icons-hint: Icons on a 24×24 grid; type to filter and click one to inspect its name and call site.
design.icons-sprites-hint: Heroes, interference monsters and achievement badges; only integer scales stay crisp.
design.colors-hint: Swatches read the live CSS variables; switching scheme or light/dark changes both the swatch and its value.
design.colors-schemes-hint: All 11 schemes share one set of semantic names; pick one to apply it across the site.
design.colors-live: Values come from runtime computed styles, not a hardcoded color table
design.type-hint: 4 families, type sizes in multiples of 6, weight fixed at 400; emphasis comes from family and color.
design.type-weight-desc: The bitmap font has only 400; font-bold / semibold / medium are banned. Readable-font mode swaps in Geist while headings stay pixel.
design.type-readable-hint: Switches body and mono to Geist; heading families stay unchanged.
design.motion-hint: Durations and easings come from tokens; hit replay for frame animation. Every easing is steps(), never smooth interpolation.
design.motion-reduced-hint: Turning pixel motion off collapses every transition to one frame; the OS reduce-motion setting does the same.
design.states-hint: Switch one control group through every state and watch borders, text colors, focus rings and ARIA attributes change.
design.states-lab-hint: Pick a state; the buttons, input and switch below all switch together.
design.states-hover-hint: Move the pointer over a button or tab focus onto it to see the live feedback.
design.states-error-hint: Error is triggered by aria-invalid; a readable error message is shown alongside.
design.states-aria-hint: States never live in class names: inspect :disabled, aria-busy, aria-invalid and aria-pressed.
design.comp-index-hint: Every reusable piece of the control kit, radio combo parts and shared display parts, grouped by family. Each sub-tab below has a live example.
design.comp-advanced-input-hint: Number steppers, custom date and time pickers, radio groups, rich selects, toggles, label pairing and three control sizes. Current values are echoed below.
design.comp-actions-hint: Link buttons, file pick and drop, two-choice confirm, toasts and a single-button message dialog.
design.comp-confirm-desc: This step cannot be undone. Confirm before running it.
design.comp-message-desc: A message dialog has a single button; the page owns its open state.
design.comp-file-drop-hint: Drop a file here or pick one.
design.comp-global-note: These three are site-wide singletons: mounted once at the app root, pages only call the service functions and never render them again.
design.comp-data-hint: Two table densities plus an empty state, sort markers, pagination, a result count and incremental loading.
design.comp-radio-hint: Screen, seven-segment readout, S-meter, level cells, dial, signal bars, battery, tuning scale and interference signature — all driven by radio semantics.
design.comp-radio-controls: Drag the sliders to change the S-meter, signal bars, battery, level cells and interference strength. The dial supports dragging, wheel and arrow keys.
design.comp-placeholders-hint: Empty, error, loading, skeleton and in-card loading placeholder — three distinct situations: no data, something failed, still waiting.
design.comp-empty-desc: An empty state means there really is no data, and it can offer a next step.
design.comp-error-detail: Demo error code E-DEMO; press the button to retry.
design.modern-subtitle: The modern component spec is being put together; this is a placeholder for now.
design.modern-empty-desc: The full interactive spec currently covers only Pixel UI. Modern components, icons, palette, type, motion and states will be added later.
design.modern-switch: Switch to Pixel UI for the full spec
design.modern-note: The two skins share no class names or design tokens, so this branch renders no pixel components.
